title.it: Pandemia COVID-19: narrative su vaccini e regolatori
title.en: COVID-19 pandemic: narratives about vaccines and regulators

description.it: Il SEAE rileva messaggi fuorvianti diffusi da media/reti collegati a Russia e Cina, anche contro vaccini occidentali ed EMA; impatto clinico attribuibile non misurato.
description.en: The EEAS identifies misleading messages spread by media/networks linked to Russia and China, including against Western vaccines and the EMA; attributable clinical impact not measured.
